Heavy-Duty Industrial Hydraulic Press (500 Ton)
Overview
The CBM-500 Industrial Press is built for continuous, high-precision metal forming, stamping, and deep drawing operations. Engineered with high-grade structural steel and advanced hydraulic control systems to maximize daily factory throughput.

Key Technical Specifications
Operating Pressure: 500 Metric Tons

Motor Power: 45 kW / 60 HP (3-Phase)

Stroke Length: 800 mm

Max Working Table Size: 1200 x 1200 mm

Control System: Semi-Automatic & Fully Manual Override

Safety Features: Dual Palm Control Button & Infrared Light Curtain

Key Features & Capabilities
Precision Guidance: Features 8-side guide rails for minimal deflection during high-pressure operations.

Energy Saver Unit: Variable displacement pump reduces power consumption during idle periods by up to 30%.

Heavy Structural Frame: Stress-relieved steel frame ensures zero structural distortion under peak load conditions.

Maintenance & Operational Guidelines
Please ensure daily lubrication checks before starting operation. Hydraulic oil (ISO VG 68) must be replaced every 3,000 working hours. Comes with a standard 12-month CBM Machineries warranty covering main hydraulic pumps and structural components.

## Terms & Conditions

### 1. Quotations & Orders

All quotations are valid for 30 days from the date of issue unless stated otherwise. Orders are confirmed only after written acceptance and receipt of the agreed advance payment.

### 2. Pricing

Prices are quoted in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) and exclude applicable taxes, duties, and shipping unless explicitly stated. CBM Machineries reserves the right to revise pricing in case of significant currency or supply chain fluctuations before an order is confirmed.

### 3. Delivery

Delivery timelines are estimates based on current stock and manufacturer lead times. While we strive to meet every committed date, delays caused by circumstances beyond our control are not grounds for order cancellation without prior agreement.

### 4. Warranty

All machinery is covered by a 12-month service warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, unauthorised modification, or failure to follow the operating manual.

### 5. Returns

Returns are accepted only for defective equipment reported within 7 days of delivery. Custom-ordered or modified machinery is non-returnable.

### 6. Liability

CBM Machineries' liability is limited to the value of the machinery supplied. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from equipment failure.
